mapper.select: SELECT TEMP.FINPROD_ID finprodId, TEMP.B_CCY bCcy, TEMP.shartAmt, 0 AS branch, FPT.TYPE_9 type9, FPT.TYPE_10 type10, FPT.TYPE_11 type11, FPT.TYPE_12 type12 FROM (SELECT FINPROD_ID, B_CCY, SUM(SHARE_AMT) shartAmt FROM PTL_SEC_VALUTION WHERE DATE_FORMAT(CDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') = #{benchDate} GROUP BY FINPROD_ID, B_CCY) TEMP LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE FPT ON TEMP.FINPROD_ID = FPT.FINPROD_ID AND FPT.BRANCH = '0'

SELECT prd_plan_detail.prd_plan_seris_id prdPlanSerisId, prd_plan_detail.prd_plan_seris_name prdPlanSerisName, prd_plan_detail.plan_target_amt/10000 as planTargetAmt, prd_plan_detail.plan_change_amt/10000 as planChangeAmt,
case when prd_plan_detail.is_new = 'Y' then '是' when prd_plan_detail.is_new = 'N' then '否' else '' end as isNew
FROM prd_plan_detail left join prd_plan_info ON prd_plan_detail.prd_plan_code = prd_plan_info.prd_plan_code WHERE prd_plan_detail.plan_change_amt > 0
and prd_plan_info.vdate = STR_TO_DATE(#{vdate}, '%Y-%m-%d') and prd_plan_info.edate = STR_TO_DATE(#{edate}, '%Y-%m-%d')
